name: Dynamite's Action News: OK K.O.!
storyline: Lakewood Plaza's been overcast by a bizarre fog! Interview your way to the truth and unfold the MYSTery of it's origins in order to save the city from it's confusion effects!
summary:
Dynamite's Action News is a mobile game in the OK K.O.! Let's Be Heroes franchise. It was developed by Wake Robin Games, a three-person studio in Portland, OR, who beat out 200 independent developers to win a fully-funded contract. With the initial game concepts completed in just under 48 hours, the game won Cartoon Network's first ever Game Jam at Pax East 2017.

It has been taken off the App Store in 2020 and can no longer be downloaded, alongside any other OK K.O. focused app games.
